iucn_korea_partnership_news.title: Advancing Biodiversity Conservation: IUCN-Republic of Korea Global Red List Partnership Completes Successful Project
iucn_korea_partnership_news.outcome: Project Sept 2020 - Sept 2023; 189 assessments of ROK native species; aim stated as status of 'ROK's endemic species'. 24 seaweed/algae species, 'all species have been assessed for the global Red List': Ceramiales 14, Gelidales 5, Acrochaetiales 1, Ectocarpales 2, Laminariales 1, Bryopsidales 1. The page names no seaweed species and mentions unspecified 'additional draft assessments'. Other groups were freshwater fish and freshwater/terrestrial invertebrates; no marine fishes or ascidians.
iucn_korea_partnership_news.note: The 24 names are the Korean-described algae in the GBIF mirror of 2026-1; their order counts match the IUCN page exactly. None is one of our species. All are Korean endemics or recently described species, so an 'in review' assessment of our widespread species under this partnership is implausible; none was found.
